messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — Cedarbrook Labs interview confirmed for Tue 3/8 at 10am PT. We need: customer quote for the case study, legal signoff, and a two-sentence blurb for the launch post. Can owners confirm?

sam: I'll own the quote collection. Jordan pls loop in the AE notes.

jordan: Pinged Cedarbrook. They said they'll share a product metric & a short customer outcome. ETA EOD Mon.

devin: I'll prep the consent/quote release form and send to Cedarbrook now. link: https://forms.redwood.internal/consent (placeholder)

claire: Quick note from legal — please don't publish any performance numbers that aren't in the signed NDA. If they want to share throughput/latency, we need explicit approval.

maria: Got it. Sam — can you ask them to separate "business outcome" language from raw numbers? We can publish the outcome safely while we wait for legal.

sam: Sure. Suggested ask to customer: 1) 1–2 sentence outcome, 2) one quote line we can use, 3) permission for a short video clip if possible.

jordan: Sent this email: 
```
Hi Team — can you provide a 1–2 sentence outcome, a quote, and permission to publish a short clip? Also let us know if any numbers require extra signoff.
Thanks,
Jordan
```

maria: For the launch plan — surface timeline: blog post + social thread + 30-min webinar with Cedarbrook as a guest. Do we have speakers?

marco: Ops can support webinar infra. Who's owning registration & routing inbound leads?

devin: I'll own registration and lead routing. We should map answers to leads: enterprise interest -> AE (Jordan), pilot interest -> CSM (Devin), press -> Maria.

claire: After we receive the quote, I'll do a fast-track review (24-48h). If any edits, I'll mark them inline and flag to Sam.

maria: Perfect. Sam — can you drop the quote into this thread when you get it and include the customer's exact attribution (name/title/company) so legal can review?

launch-bot: webinar placeholder created: Cedarbrook Case Study — Tue 3/22 10am PT. Registration URL: https://events.redwood.internal/cedarbrook

sam: Got an initial quote back: "Redwood cut our inference costs by ~45% while keeping latency <100ms — it unlocked real-time features for our app." Attribution: Alex Park, CTO, Cedarbrook Labs.

claire: Received. Need to remove the "~" shorthand and confirm the 45% figure source. Sam — did they run a cost delta report?

sam: Asking them for the report now. If they can't share the exact calc, can we publish: "significantly reduced inference costs, enabling real-time features"?

claire: That's safe. Also please remove specific latency number until we get supporting logs.

maria: Ok we'll use the safer phrasing in the initial social/blog draft and update if/when legal clears numbers. Drafting short thread now — will post here for approvals. :memo:

jordan: Cedarbrook also confirmed a 2-min customer video is possible — they'll record before 3/15.

devin: Great. Once video is in, I'll add it to the webinar assets and the lead follow-up workflows.

maria: Thanks team. Everyone — please react with :thumbsup: if you can meet the 3/15 asset freeze. Otherwise flag blockers now.

sam: :thumbsup: 

claire: :thumbsup: 

marco: :thumbsup: 

jordan: :thumbsup: 

devin: :thumbsup:
